attempts.query:
PREFIX energia: <https://w3id.org/rastro/energia#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
SELECT ?wellId WHERE {
  ?run a energia:ModelRun ; energia:current true .
  ?p a energia:Prediction ; prov:wasGeneratedBy ?run ; energia:inTest true ; energia:aboutWell ?w ; energia:predictedGas ?gas .
  ?w energia:wellId ?wellId .
}
ORDER BY DESC(?gas)
LIMIT 3
